context.goal: Sign on to the teller console, look up member {{member_id}}, open a new {{product}} sub-account funded with an initial deposit of {{initial_deposit}} from the member's Share Savings (suffix S01), confirm it, and read the confirmation number.
recent_actions: 6. click button "Search" — ok (Submit the member lookup search.)
7. click link "Open Sub-Account" — ok (Open the sub-account creation form for this member.)
8. select combobox "Product:" = {{product}} — ok (Select the requested sub-account product.)
9. fill textbox "Initial Deposit:" = {{initial_deposit}} — ok (Enter the initial deposit amount to fund the new sub-account.)
10. click button "Continue" — ok (Submit the sub-account form to proceed to the confirmation step.)
